name: peernet
description: Full-stack social media platform. The workspace root only orchestrates the backend and frontend packages, which hold their own dependencies.

scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run preview --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build:prod: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend && rm -rf backend/public && mkdir -p backend/public && cp -r frontend/dist/* backend/public/ && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
